name: Skip Step
description: Skip across the space ahead in one short hop that leaves the ground behind without a sound.

name: Skip Palm
description: Skip into range and push a palm into the chest in the same breath.

name: Leap Sense
description: Feel the open ground a hop away and judge whether a safe landing waits there.

name: Skip Guard
description: Hop a hand's breadth aside as the blow falls so it passes through the place the body had held.

name: Double Skip
description: Skip twice in a single breath to cross a wide gap and arrive behind a foe.

name: Triple Skip
description: Skip round a foe in three quick hops and strike once from each side before they can turn.

name: Pleat Palm
description: Strike with a palm whose reach has been pleated short so it lands before the foe sees it start.

name: Pleat Brace
description: Fold several pleats of space across the chest so a blow loses force at each one.

name: Pleat Probe
description: Press a pleat of qi outward and read the shape of whatever lies in the way.

name: Pleat Hook
description: Swing a hooked fist through a pleat so it turns the corner of the guard and lands on the jaw.

name: Pleat Slip
description: Slip through a narrow pleat of space and come out a pace to the side.

name: Deep Pleat
description: Gather the space before the user into a thick stack of pleats that smothers a heavy strike.

name: Pleat Rend
description: Pull a pleat open at the foe's body so the tearing space cuts through guard and skin.

name: Likeness Step
description: Step toward the place where the user's likeness stands and swap with it.

name: Glint Jab
description: Jab at the reflection of the fist so the true blow lands a half beat behind its image.

name: Image Guard
description: Leave a shimmering likeness at the guard line so the foe's blow strikes only the image.

name: Twin Glance
description: Look through the likeness as well as the eyes and see a foe from two places at once.

name: Double Image
description: Cast two likenesses to either side of the body so a foe cannot tell the true one.

name: Cast-Back Palm
description: Turn the foe's strike through the mirrored plane so the blow rebounds on its sender.

name: Lattice Sense
description: Read the fine lattice of space about the body and find where it is bent or strained.

name: Lattice Palm
description: Strike along a strut of the lattice so the blow carries straight to its end.

name: Lattice Step
description: Place each foot on a node of the lattice and cross open ground in even steps.

name: Lattice Buttress
description: Brace the body on three struts of the lattice so a blow spreads across them.

name: Node Mark
description: Mark the node under a foe's lead foot so every later hit knows exactly where to land.

name: Strut Jab
description: Jab the point of a finger down a lattice strut into a narrow place on the foe.

name: Lattice Lock
description: Pin a foe's limbs to the nodes about them so they cannot slip out of the frame.

name: Lattice Cut
description: Snap a whole row of struts so the space they frame shears across a group of foes.

name: Seam Palm
description: Strike at the line where the foe's guard overlaps and push through the join.

name: Seam Read
description: Look for the seam in a foe's stance and know which side of the body is weakest.

name: Seam Slip
description: Slip along a seam in the space beside a foe and come out at their shoulder.

name: Seam Brace
description: Close the seam in the space before the body and take a blow on the mended join.

name: Seam Prick
description: Drive a stiffened finger into the gap between plates of armor or ribs of the guard.

name: Guard Rift
description: Split the space along a foe's guard seam so the whole stance gapes open.

name: Seam Tear
description: Tear a seam under a charging foe so the stride breaks off in mid-air.

name: Inward Palm
description: Strike with a palm that draws the space inward at the moment of contact and pulls the blow deeper.

name: Inward Guard
description: Draw the space round the body inward to form a tight skin that turns a blow.

name: Inward Stride
description: Draw the far spot toward the user and step onto it in one motion.

name: Inward Sense
description: Draw in the faint pull of nearby spatial users and learn their direction and strength.

name: Inward Pull
description: Pull the space about a foe's limbs inward so the arms fold against the chest.

name: Inward Crush
description: Draw the space inward over a small group so each foe is squeezed from all sides.

name: Spiral Step
description: Turn the body through a tight spiral of space and end a pace round a foe's flank.

name: Spiral Palm
description: Throw a palm down a spiral line so it strikes from the far side of the guard.

name: Spiral Guard
description: Turn the arm in a spiral across the blow and roll its force off the body.

name: Spiral Jab
description: Corkscrew a jab through a twist of space to land on the point of the chin.

name: Spiral Sense
description: Trace a spiral of qi outward and learn where bodies and walls lie about the user.

name: Spiral Flick
description: Flick a stone into a spiral flight that curls in on a distant target.

name: Spiral Reach
description: Wind the arm through a long spiral and let the strike arrive from where the foe did not guard.

name: Spiral Drive
description: Drive a spinning point of space through the guard and deep into the body.
